title: The association of anxiety, depression, developmental disabilities, and congenital heart disease in US children and adolescents
authors: Yu B; Li B; Deng X; Tang J; Chen R; Guo T
date_caveat: Newly encountered in overlapping scan; PubMed entry predates previous observed cutoff. Indexing lag or retrieval changes are not proven causes. No publication after cutoff established.
population: US caregiver-reported NSCH 2022–2023, ages 6–17; analyzed n=52,846. Chronic-condition and missingness exclusions limit generalization. No adult cohort.
exposure: Caregiver-reported congenital heart disease; comparator no CHD
outcome: Caregiver-reported Tourette condition and current severity categories; Tourette exploratory, not one of four primary outcomes. No clinical tic-severity assessment or follow-up.
table_prose_discrepancy: Prose describes higher moderate/severe association, but Table 3 prints 0.68 versus 1.32 for mild. Retain both; no repair or supported directional severity inference.
model: Weighted multivariable/multinomial logistic models adjusted demographic, birth, household, activity and poverty covariates.
precision_and_nulls: Overall and severity CIs include 1; do not infer equivalence or no association.
risk_of_bias: Cross-sectional caregiver reports and differential diagnostic surveillance
Exploratory multiple outcomes, sparse Tourette subgroup precision
funding_conflicts: Hospital talent fund and Guizhou provincial innovation-talent support; authors declare no competing interests.
claim_supported: Null-compatible published overall estimate; no causal, treatment, adult-burden or individual-risk conclusion.
claim_not_supported: CHD causes tics, greater moderate/severe Tourette association, or changes to clinical care.
cohort_overlap: NSCH 2022–2023; independent sample overlap with other NSCH papers not audited.
access: Publisher full text and tables read transiently; no source full text or participant records retained. Supplement not inspected.
reviewer: AI-assisted public evidence review with independent cell check
correction_retraction_check: PubMed linked notices absent in current metadata; publisher discrepancy retained, not a misconduct allegation.
next_verification_task: Only revisit directional severity claim if authoritative correction or clarifying public documentation appears. No author contact authorized.
